lead: A `loop-goal.toml` fixture check whose frozen `want` belongs to a later stage fails until that stage lands, and reads as a regression.
body: `tools/loop.py` stops each sweep at its first failure, sorted by stage, so one such fixture can hide every check behind it; `.loop/log.md`'s `goal cost: Ns over N check(s)` is the line that says the sweep was cut short. Read the `[[check]]` block's `stage` before believing the banner, and never rewrite the fixture to print the frozen strings — the output is frozen and the source is not.
